plugins.name: e2e-video-doc
plugins.description: Walks the application like a real user and produces a narrated video, screenshots and the detail of each API call. The walkthrough is an E2E test: when it breaks, the screen changed.

plugins.name: session-handoff
plugins.description: Turns a working session with an agent into a 3–4 minute briefing the rest of the team can listen to. The conversation is the source; the document diff is the ground truth.

plugins.name: empresas-ar
plugins.description: Cross-references Argentine companies by CUIT, domain and email: validates the identifiers, then matches the company across Fugazzeta, Keventer, Gmail and OpenArg public data.
